# Labels must reference existing compiled components

Labelled components in the ground truth file must exist among compiled components for the evaluated repository, otherwise execution fails with an error.

To prevent silent mis-scoring or baseline corruption by human typo or label drift, ensuring all evaluation is against verified entities.
